To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the mediating role of perceived value has a significant effect on the relationship between the relational orientation and the customer loyalty in the Lebanese banking sector, and that the crisis situation and the personal information of the managers have significant effects on the customer loyalty.
(1) the relationship between the relationship orientation and customer loyalty is positive, and (2) perceived value mediates the effect of the relationship orientation on customer loyalty.

(1) the relational approach is a major factor in the loyalty of customers, (2) perceived value has a significant effect on loyalty, (3) relational approach and perceived value play a significant role in the loyalty of the customer, (4) the crisis has a significant effect in the loyalty of customer, and (5) the demographic variables have an effect in the loyalty.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of perceived value on customer loyalty in a relational context.
the approaches used to retain clients.
the approaches that allow the retention of the customers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the value perceived by customers is a mediator that plays an important role in the customer loyalty.
the perceived value plays a mediating role between the relationship marketing and customer loyalty.
the perceived value plays a mediating role in the effect of relational orientation on loyalty.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have studied the effect of perceived value in a relational marketing context, and the role that it plays in the loyalty of consumers.
the relationship between the customer and the bank is not only a commercial relationship, but also a relationship of trust and loyalty.
it is a study of the role of the mediator that the perceived value has on the relationship between the bank and the customer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the perceived value plays a mediating role in the relationship between the relational approach and the customer loyalty.
the perceived value is a mediating role in customer relationship loyalty in a situation of instability.
the perceived value plays a mediating role between relational marketing and customer loyalty.
